title: Dietary guidance from the International Organization for the Study of Inflammatory Bowel Diseases
authors: Levine A, Rhodes JM, Lindsay JO, Abreu MT, Kamm MA, Gibson PR, et al.
authorConflicts: Several authors declared honoraria, consultancies, patents or grants from companies including Nestle Health Science, Janssen, AbbVie, Takeda and Pfizer.
result: Consensus of the IOIBD nutrition cluster (agreement above 75% required). In Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis it may be prudent to reduce intake of processed foods containing carrageenan, carboxymethylcellulose and polysorbate 80; evidence level very low, agreement 92.3%.
